---
description: Apply Spring Boot security best practices
---

Act as a senior application security engineer.

Review the selected implementation.

Validate compliance with:

- OWASP Top 10
- Secure Spring Boot development
- Secure REST API design
- Enterprise cloud-native practices

Review:

- controllers
- services
- DTOs
- Kafka consumers
- Kafka producers
- AWS integrations
- OpenShift configuration

Check for:

- input validation
- insecure deserialization
- injection vulnerabilities
- path traversal
- SSRF
- XXE
- information disclosure
- excessive permissions
- insecure configuration

Validate:

- authentication
- authorization
- secret handling
- file upload validation
- exception handling

Never allow:

- hardcoded passwords
- API keys in code
- tokens in code
- secrets in configuration files
- disabled security controls
